column1: # Every catalogue host in the Digital Agency's 2026-06-30 list of open-data municipalities (1,648 rows,
# columns URL1..URL3) that was NOT already a registered host, platform-detected live on 2026-10-17 by
# asking each for the CKAN, OpenDataSoft, ArcGIS-Hub DCAT and dataeye catalogue paths and JUDGING THE BODY.
# Result: 776 hosts, 1 CKAN (holding one dataset), 0 ODS, 3 ArcGIS Hub (all three already walked by the
# tree via /api/search/v1), and the rest answer 404 on every path or 200 on every path (a catch-all
# municipal site). The "open-data site" column of that list is overwhelmingly an HTML page, not an API.
# The feeds those same sites declare are a different matter: see candidate-sources-batch42.jprss.txt.
